mapper.select: SELECT pb.plan_id, p.plan_code, d.benefit_code, d.benefit_name, d.category, pb.benefit_value, d.value_type, d.unit, d.reset_type, d.preview_only = 1 AS preview_only, d.enabled = 1 AS definition_enabled, pb.enabled = 1 AS plan_enabled FROM ai_membership_plan_benefit pb JOIN ai_membership_plan p ON p.id = pb.plan_id AND p.deleted = 0 JOIN ai_membership_benefit_definition d ON d.id = pb.benefit_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE pb.plan_id = #{planId} AND pb.deleted = 0 AND (pb.effective_time IS NULL OR pb.effective_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (pb.expire_time IS NULL OR pb.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY d.display_order, d.id
